core: Type I/III interferon and IL-20 family cytokine responses
qualifier: epithelial wound-healing context
name: Type I/III interferon and IL-20 family epithelial responses
rationale: Members are interferon-alpha, type III (lambda) interferon and IL-20 family signaling plus epithelial wound-healing regulation, which separates the theme from the IL-10/IL-12, IL-17 and IL-15/NK confusables.

qualifier: GDP-mannose, dolichol-phosphate mannose and GPI anchoring
name: GDP-mannose and dolichol-phosphate mannose synthesis with GPI anchoring
rationale: All members build GDP-mannose, dolichol phosphate or dolichol-phosphate mannose (and their CDG defects) or use them for GPI anchor synthesis, whereas confusables instead cover ALG-mediated N-glycan assembly or UDP-GlcNAc synthesis.

qualifier: methylglyoxal and aldehyde detoxification
name: Glutathione metabolism and methylglyoxal/aldehyde detoxification
rationale: Members cover glutathione synthesis, recycling, transport and their inherited defects plus glutathione-dependent methylglyoxal/aldehyde detoxification and deglycase protein repair, distinguishing it from transsulfuration, ROS/NADPH and cofactor confusables.

qualifier: complex IV and respirasome assembly
name: Mitochondrial electron transport and respiratory complex IV assembly
rationale: Members are respiratory chain electron transfer, chemiosmotic ATP formation and assembly of complex IV, complex I and respirasomes, whereas confusables emphasize complex III assembly, membrane insertion and mitochondrial translation.

core: Mycobacterium tuberculosis subversion of host defenses
qualifier: apoptosis, autophagy and energy metabolism suppression
name: Mycobacterium tuberculosis suppression of host apoptosis, autophagy and immunity
rationale: All members are Mtb strategies that inhibit host cell defenses (apoptosis, autophagy, membrane repair, NO, phagolysosome fusion, metabolism), distinct from confusables on phagosome acidification, iron assimilation or bacterial toxins.

core: Canonical Wnt activation at the FZD/LRP receptor level
qualifier: RNF43-mediated FZD ubiquitination
name: Canonical Wnt receptor activation and RNF43-mediated FZD ubiquitination
rationale: Members concern receptor-proximal canonical Wnt events (ligand antagonists, LRP5, DVL activation, AXIN recruitment to the membrane) plus RNF43/ubiquitin control of FZD, which the non-canonical, ligand-secretion and beta-catenin/TCF confusables lack.

qualifier: RUNX3, FOXO and PAX3 targets
name: RUNX3, FOXO and PAX3 transcription of growth-suppressor genes
rationale: Most members are transcriptional programs (RUNX3 on CDKN1A/BIM/p14-ARF, FOXO cell-cycle genes, PTEN transcription, PAX3 targets) controlling proliferation and apoptosis, unlike confusables centered on CDH1, TGF-beta/SMAD or RUNX3-WNT/YAP regulation.

core: Postsynaptic actin remodeling in structural plasticity
qualifier: NMDAR-RAC1 signaling and dendrite arborization
name: Postsynaptic actin remodeling, synaptic plasticity and dendrite arborization
rationale: Members share postsynaptic cytoskeletal and structural regulation of synapses and dendrites, with NMDAR-driven RAC1 activation, PSD maintenance and dendrite arborization distinguishing it from filopodium/EPHB and BDNF/NTRK2 confusables.

qualifier: involution
name: Mammary alveolar development, lactation and involution
rationale: Members cover mammary epithelial proliferation, alveolar differentiation, lactation and involution (with one hyperoxia-response outlier), whereas confusables cover mammary lineages, ductal branching or placental development.

core: Cranial sensory organ and cranial nerve development
qualifier: ear and olfactory system
name: Ear, olfactory system and cranial nerve development
rationale: Members are inner, middle and outer ear, nose/olfactory and cranial nerve/ganglion development (including GnRH neuron migration from the olfactory region), distinguishing it from eye, face/skull and gland confusables.

qualifier: nuclear splicing, 3'-end processing and export
name: mRNA nuclear processing, export, stabilization and decay
rationale: Members span mRNA fate control from splicing, 3'-end processing and export to stabilization (IGF2BP, CRD), NMD/deadenylation inhibition and decapping decay, with the nuclear processing/export steps separating it from ARE-binding decay and polyadenylation confusables.

qualifier: gap filling and abasic sugar-phosphate removal
name: Base excision repair gap filling and abasic site processing
rationale: All four members are the post-incision BER steps (POLB single-nucleotide and long-patch repair, gap filling), distinct from glycosylase recognition, OGG1 defects, translesion synthesis and replication confusables.

core: Cellular responses to ethanol, nicotine and anesthetics
qualifier: agmatine and nitric oxide regulation
name: Responses to ethanol, nicotine and anesthetics with agmatine/NO regulation
rationale: Members are responses to ethanol, nicotine, ether and anesthetics (including an alcohol-dependence gene module) plus agmatine synthesis and suppression of amine and NO biosynthesis, which distinguishes it from drug, xenobiotic and AhR response confusables.

qualifier: exploration, grooming and proprioception
name: Locomotion, exploration, grooming and proprioceptive motor behavior
rationale: Members are locomotory, exploratory, grooming, righting and psychomotor behaviors with proprioception and supporting cerebellar/amygdala development, while confusables emphasize glycinergic transmission, vocalization and auditory or touch behaviors.

The five members are unrelated gene modules (mitochondrial respiratory housekeeping, Polycomb chromatin repression, generic ubiquitination, centrosome/mitosis, RB1/BCL2L1 survival control) with no shared biological process; only a loose ubiquitin link touches the proteasome/neddylation confusables.

core: Glutamate receptor signaling in synaptic plasticity and memory
qualifier: NMDAR calcium-CaMK/cAMP-CREB signaling to the nucleus
name: NMDA receptor-Ca2+-CREB signaling in synaptic plasticity and memory
rationale: Members cover NMDA/AMPA receptor activation and trafficking, LTP/LTD and memory, with calcium-driven CaMK, adenylyl cyclase and AMPK cascades to CREB/NPAS4 transcription separating it from structural-plasticity and kainate/AMPA-activation confusables.

qualifier: nuclear-cytosolic methylation and box C/D snoRNPs
name: Nuclear rRNA, tRNA and snRNA methylation and snoRNP assembly
rationale: Members are methylation and modification of cytosolic/nuclear rRNA, tRNA and snRNA with box C/D snoRNP assembly and localization, distinguishing it from rRNA cleavage processing, mitochondrial RNA modification and pseudouridylation confusables.

qualifier: membrane potential regulation
name: Mitochondrial protein targeting and membrane potential regulation
rationale: Members concern establishing and maintaining protein localization to mitochondria and regulating (mitochondrial) membrane potential, unlike confusables on mitophagy, fission/fusion and BCL-2-family apoptotic permeabilization.

qualifier: complex III/IV assembly and inner-membrane protein insertion
name: Mitochondrial electron transport, complex III/IV assembly and inner-membrane insertion
rationale: Members are respiratory chain electron transfer and chemiosmotic coupling plus assembly of complexes III, IV, I and respirasomes and inner-membrane insertion, while confusables add complex I biogenesis, ATP synthase, Fe-S clusters or mitochondrial translation.

qualifier: peptidyl methylation and acetylation of proteins including TP53 and tubulin
name: Peptidyl lysine/arginine methylation and protein acetylation
rationale: Members are protein-level lysine mono/di/trimethylation, arginine methylation and lysine, N-terminal and histone acetylation (incl. TP53 methylation, tubulin acetylation), unlike confusables built around BAF/CHD remodelers and histone-modifying complexes.

qualifier: HGF/MET plus TGF-beta/activin receptors and their cancer mutants
name: HGF/MET and TGF-beta/activin receptor signaling with cancer mutants
rationale: Members are MET receptor activation and downstream effectors plus TGF-beta, activin, AMH and TGFBR3 signaling and TGFBR/SMAD cancer mutants; the TGF-beta superfamily half separates it from PI3K/ALK, PTK6/ERBB and liver confusables.

qualifier: ER-centered contact sites and ER organization
name: ER-centered intermembrane lipid transfer and organelle tethering
rationale: Members are non-vesicular transfer of phospholipids, glycolipids, ceramide-1-phosphate and cholesterol between membranes with ER localization, ER-plasma membrane tethering and ER/Golgi traffic, separating it from flippase, mitochondrial tethering, RAB prenylation and lipid catabolism confusables.

qualifier: piRNA transposon silencing and sperm/zygote chromatin remodeling
name: piRNA transposon silencing and germline-to-zygote chromatin reprogramming
rationale: Members cover piRNA biogenesis and retroelement silencing, sperm chromatin condensation and protamine replacement, oocyte construction, and zygotic epigenetic programming/genome activation, which the cleavage, germ-cell specification, imprinting and maternal mRNA decay confusables lack in combination.

core: Cell cycle G2/M progression and mitotic exit
qualifier: APC/C and SCF ubiquitin-ligase control of cyclins
name: APC/C- and SCF-controlled G2/M progression and mitotic exit
rationale: Members are G2/M transition, checkpoint and mitotic exit events dominated by APC/C (Cdc20/Cdh1) and SCF-mediated degradation of cyclins, Emi1 and CDK inhibitors, plus DREAM/p53 G2 arrest transcription, distinguishing it from E2F/G1-S, DNA replication and spindle/cohesion confusables.

qualifier: subversion and nutrient acquisition by Mycobacterium tuberculosis
name: Phagosome maturation and Mycobacterium tuberculosis subversion of host defenses
rationale: Members are phagosome acidification and lysosome fusion together with Mtb strategies blocking them and other host defenses and acquiring iron/heme, unlike Listeria entry, peptide transport/neutrophil granule and toxin confusables.
